# Drivers: the keys of each type

<!-- Generated by tools/skill/gen_reference.js from tools/designer/renderer/js/schema.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

One object of `"drivers"` in project.json per connection: `{ "type": "<type>", "name": "<optional>", "enabled": true, ... }`.
Only what is listed here exists. **How to add or change a driver safely: drivers-guide.md** (only when the user asks).

## `sim` — Simulation

`items` (Items): an array of rows. Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `mode` | `sine` / `triangle` / `ramp` / `square` / `random` / `counter` / `cycle` / `follow` |  |
| `min` | number |  |
| `max` | number |  |
| `period_ms` | number |  |
| `values` | array of texts |  |
| `when` | tag name | optional.  |
| `target` | text | optional.  |
| `rate` | number | optional.  |
| `idle` | number | optional.  |
| `noise` | number | optional.  |

| --- | --- | --- |

## `slmp` — Mitsubishi SLMP / MC protocol (MELSEC)

| key | value | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | text |  |
| `port` | number | the SLMP port of the CPU or of the Ethernet unit (Karakuri: 5007) |
| `frame` | `3e` / `4e` |  |
| `poll_ms` | number |  |
| `timeout_ms` | number | how long to wait for an answer (default 1000) |
| `status_tag` | tag name |  |
| `network` | number | route: network number (default 0 = the station itself) |
| `pc` | number | route: PC number (default 255) |
| `io` | number | route: request destination module I/O number (default 1023 = 0x3FF, the CPU) |
| `station` | number | route: request destination station number (default 0) |
| `write_ranges` | array of texts | only these may be written, e.g. D0-D999, M0-M99 (empty = everything except SM / SD) |
| `allow_system_write` | true / false | also write SM / SD (the CPU's own relays and registers) |

`map` (Device map): an array of rows. Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `addr` | text | e.g. D100 / M0 / X1F / D10.3 |
| `dtype` | `int16` / `uint16` / `int32` / `uint32` / `float` / `string` |  |
| `length` | number | optional.  |
| `scale` | number |  |
| `offset` | number |  |
| `access` | `rw` / `ro` / `wo` |  |
| `swap_words` | true / false | optional.  |

## `fins` — OMRON FINS (FINS/TCP)

| key | value | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | text |  |
| `port` | number | the FINS/TCP port of the CPU or of the Ethernet unit (default 9600) |
| `poll_ms` | number |  |
| `timeout_ms` | number | how long to wait for an answer (default 1000) |
| `status_tag` | tag name |  |
| `dest_network` | number | route: destination network address (default 0 = the local network) |
| `dest_node` | number | route: destination node address (default 0 = the PLC the connection goes to) |
| `dest_unit` | number | route: destination unit address (default 0 = the CPU) |
| `node` | number | our own node address (default 0 = the PLC gives us one) |
| `write_ranges` | array of texts | only these may be written, e.g. D0-D999, W0-W99 (empty = everything except the Auxiliary Area) |
| `allow_system_write` | true / false | also write the Auxiliary Area (A: the CPU's own flags and settings) |

`map` (Device map): an array of rows. Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `addr` | text | e.g. D100 / CIO10 / W0.00 / H5 / E0_100 / T1 |
| `dtype` | `int16` / `uint16` / `int32` / `uint32` / `float` / `bcd16` / `bcd32` / `string` |  |
| `length` | number | optional.  |
| `scale` | number |  |
| `offset` | number |  |
| `access` | `rw` / `ro` / `wo` |  |
| `swap_words` | true / false | optional.  |

## `mqtt` — MQTT client

| key | value | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | text | the broker |
| `port` | number | default 8883 (TLS), 1883 without TLS |
| `tls` | true / false | encrypted (TLS 1.2 / 1.3). Without it user name, password and values can be read on the network |
| `verify` | true / false | check the broker's certificate and host name. Without it anybody on the way can pretend to be the broker |
| `ca_file` | text | the CA certificate of the broker (PEM), relative to project.json. On Linux the system's CAs when empty |
| `cert_file` | text | client certificate (PEM), if the broker wants one |
| `key_file` | text | its private key (PEM) |
| `client_id` | text | unique per device |
| `topic_prefix` | text | put before every topic, e.g. plant/line1/pump1/ |
| `status_topic` | text | "online" (retained) while connected, "offline" as the last will |
| `status_tag` | tag name |  |
| `payload` | `value` / `json` | value: 21.5 / json: {"v": 21.5, "ts": ms} |
| `qos` | `0` / `1` | default of the published tags |
| `retain` | true / false | default of the published tags |
| `keepalive_s` | number |  |
| `timeout_ms` | number | connect / handshake (default 5000) |
| `reconnect_ms` | number | first wait before connecting again; doubles up to 30 s (default 1000) |

`publish` (Publish (tag values to the broker)): an array of rows (a row may also be just the tag name). Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `topic` | text | e.g. (the tag name) |
| `mode` | `change` / `interval` |  |
| `interval_ms` | number |  |
| `qos` | `0` / `1` |  |
| `retain` | true / false | optional.  |

`subscribe` (Subscribe (commands: only these tags can be written)): an array of rows (a row may also be just the tag name). Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `topic` | text | e.g. (the tag name) |

## `opcua_client` — OPC UA client

| key | value | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | text | opc.tcp://host:4840 of the server |
| `security` | `sign_encrypt` / `sign` / `none` | none: values can be read and changed on the network |
| `policy` | text | e.g. Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep |
| `server_cert` | text | the server's certificate (DER / PEM) to trust, relative to project.json; more can be put in pki/trusted/ on the device |
| `verify` | true / false | check the server's certificate. Without it anybody on the way can pretend to be the server |
| `cert_file` | text | this client's certificate (DER). Empty: the device makes one at the first start (pki/own/opcua_client.der); the server has to trust it |
| `key_file` | text | its private key |
| `application_uri` | text | must be the URI in the client certificate |
| `publish_ms` | number | how often the server sends changes (default 500) |
| `timeout_ms` | number | connect (default 5000) |
| `reconnect_ms` | number | first wait before connecting again; doubles up to 30 s (default 1000) |
| `status_tag` | tag name |  |

`map` (Nodes): an array of rows. Columns:

| column | value | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | tag name |  |
| `node` | text | e.g. ns=2;s=Temp / nsu=urn:...;i=5 |
| `access` | `ro` / `rw` |  |
